title: Public Alert No. 20/2025 – Alert on the Report of Unregistered Fair Child Soap Circulating in Nigerian Markets

products.manufacturer: Produced for & marketed by Lexmart Cosmetics Ltd

summary: NAFDAC warns that "Fair Child Soap", an unregistered imported skin-lightening soap marketed for children by Lexmart Cosmetics Ltd, is being sold in Lagos retail outlets. The marketer was sanctioned and told to halt distribution; states must quarantine stock.
